title: When the Roll Is Called Up Yonder
lyrics: [G]When the trumpet of the Lord shall sound and [C]time shall be no [G]more,
And the morning breaks, eternal bright and [D7]fair;
When the [G]saved of earth shall gather over [C]on the other [G]shore,
And the roll is called up [D7]yonder, I'll be [G]there.
[G]When the roll is called up yonder.
When the [D7]roll is called up yonder.
When the [G]roll is called up [D7]yonder I'll be [G]there.
[G]On that bright and cloudless morning, when the [C]dead in Christ shall [G]rise,
And the glory of His resurrection [D7]share;
When His [G]chosen ones shall gather to their [C]home beyond the [G]skies,
And the roll is called up [D7]yonder, I'll be [G]there.
[G]Let us labor for the Master from the [C]dawn till setting [G]sun,
Let us talk of all His wondrous love and [D7]care,
Then, when [G]all of life is over, and our [C]work on earth is [G]done,
And the roll is called up [D7]yonder, I'll be [G]there.
